reviews.decision: Both complete paths read: a modern chips-autocomplete example changes type-only imports and puts MatAutocompleteModule before MatChipsModule; chips.md documents the order and rephrases Voice Control sibling guidance. Legacy chip input and autocomplete own separate event semantics; module-order/selected-option versus typed-token interaction remains an A04 integration test lead. No legacy key handler or defaultPrevented behavior is changed or certified by this source exclusion.

They recommend direct CdkTrapFocus imports, root-provided LiveAnnouncer/MediaMatcher/BreakpointObserver services, contextual inject() examples, and moving announcements to explicit methods. No CDK service/directive source, provider declaration, focus trapping, announcement timing, media-query sanitization or lifecycle implementation changes occur.
